title: Australian Weekend Wrap
description: A delicious and easy-to-make wrap filled with fregola pasta, vegetables, and your choice of protein.

ingredients.name: Chicken Breast
ingredients.notes: Grilled or cooked in a pan

instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Grill the chicken breast for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
3. Cook the fregola pasta according to package instructions.
4. In a large bowl, combine the cooked pasta, sliced vegetables, and chopped tomato.
5. Slice the grilled chicken breast and add it to the bowl.
6. Warm the wraps by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for 2-3 minutes.
7. Assemble the wraps by spooning the pasta and vegetable mixture onto the wrap.
